title: The right adjoint of pushforward for a proper flat finite presentation morphism commutes with direct sums
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file duality.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: For a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme Y, a proper flat finite presentation morphism f : X -> Y and the right adjoint a of Rf_*, the lemma asserts that a commutes with direct sums (statement lines 2830-2863). The proof takes a perfect object P of D(O_X): by Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma labelled perfect-lemma-flat-proper-perfect-direct-image-general the complex Rf_*P is perfect on Y, and for a family K_i one computes Hom_{D(O_X)}(P, a(oplus K_i)) = Hom_{D(O_Y)}(Rf_*P, oplus K_i) = oplus Hom_{D(O_Y)}(Rf_*P, K_i) = oplus Hom_{D(O_X)}(P, a(K_i)) by adjunction and compactness of a perfect object, Derived Categories of Schemes, Proposition labelled perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (proof lines 2865-2880). Since D_QCoh(O_X) has a perfect generator by Derived Categories of Schemes, Theorem labelled perfect-theorem-bondal-van-den-Bergh, it follows that the comparison map oplus a(K_i) -> a(oplus K_i) is an isomorphism (proof lines 2880-2884). Testing an isomorphism of functors on a perfect generator and using compactness is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
